review_text: Atmosphere was great, food can be better. And there was too much delay in serving the dish.

I had an amazing experience learning resin art at the cafe. A special thanks to my mentor Charu mam for being so patient, creative, and supportive throughout the workshop. The session was fun, well-guided, and inspiring. The food was also delicious and added to the whole cozy and creative vibe of the place. Truly enjoyed learning something new in such a warm and artistic atmosphere!
Nice art cafe, food was good and the service too
